feature_contract.goal: Keep the complete native OutRun ESC/pause shell and its original option arrows in a consistent R84 per-eye optical plane across synchronous original E8 and deferred SpriteNode draws, preserving controls and correct fallbacks.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only twelve exact original ESC option-arrow ClipSprite E8 producers and the associated R84 pause-specific ScreenHud classifier are changed. Do not alter global HUD, F11, GOAL/+TIME, main menu, world, SkyGlow, input/FFB, DX11 or DXVK.
trace_stages: Native original ESC option-arrow E8 parents invoke put_clip_sprite, which may issue an immediate GPU Draw before a SpriteNode is appended or tag a deferred SpriteNode.
Exact E8 producer owner scopes synchronous drawing; existing TagAppendedNodes retains all original queued ScreenHud tags and current active SpriteNode takes precedence over nested direct ownership.

R84 R30 pause classifier reads effective screen scope and authoritative direct-or-queued producer, applying consistent per-eye XYZRHW or shader optical scaling to shell and option arrows before host composition.
subcomponents: Scope only original pause-state arrow parents with exact direct ScreenHud provenance across source-time GPU calls while preserving queued nodes and original argument/return semantics.
Use authoritative current render producer in R84 independent pause-eye classifier, matching original ESC shell shader and XYZRHW arrow optical transforms.
Cover direct and queued admission and unrelated menu/F11/GOAL fallback through C++ portable smoke and destructive source mutation tests.

diagnosis.original_evidence: The exact ESC option E8 hooks had only post-call TagAppendedNodes ScreenHud assignment; R84 classifier admitted only CurrentSpriteQueueProducer. An immediate Draw inside the original producer could be unowned despite subsequent deferred arrows being tagged.
diagnosis.root_cause: An ownership timing mismatch between synchronous ClipSprite Draw before queued-node tagging and an R84 per-eye admission predicate restricted to queued producers.
source_trace: Twelve original option-arrow callsites are installed from OptionArrow_ClipSpriteCalls in src/hooks_uiscaling.cpp.
ExactScreenHud_putClipSprite calls the unchanged native producer before TagAppendedNodes populates deferred queue semantic tags.
render_semantics.hpp CurrentRenderProducerToken selects an active SpriteNode first and exact direct E8 producer otherwise; R84 R30 previously checked only CurrentSpriteQueueProducer.
R84 pause affine helper and XYZRHW/shader branches share pause-specific per-eye correction.
alternatives_rejected: Do not globally classify ScreenHud or ScreenOverlay2D as ESC arrows; this would disturb gameplay HUD, GOAL, lens, F11 and other original UI.
Do not force D3DX Flush or broaden semantic ownership to every ClipSprite; leave native batch timing and input/FFB untouched.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Exact direct E8 RAII wrapper scopes only VR pause-arrow original calls and retains prior queued node tags. R84 classifier checks CurrentRenderProducerToken, which keeps queue priority and direct fallback. Added portable predicate negative cases and source mutation regressions.
